entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi David. I hope you can help me. I'm trying to figure out a return and I'm just so lost with your website. It's all very confusing.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear the website was confusing. Can you tell me which item you're calling about? What specifically is the issue?
It's a helmet I bought. I honestly just got overwhelmed and never even took it out of the packaging. The box is unopened, still sealed.
I understand. I can pull up your order to get started. Do you have the order number or the email address you used to purchase?
Um, let me see... I think the order was VF-86753. Can't you just help me? I don't understand the policies, and I just want to send it back.

Of course, that's what I'm here for. Let me pull up order VF-86753. Okay, I see the Aero-Lid helmet here. It looks like it was delivered about 85 days ago. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference issue?

Oh, no, it's not broken or anything. It's just the color. On the website, it looked like a bright, high-visibility yellow, which is important for my safety on the road. But when it arrived, it's more of a mustard color. I was just so disappointed I never even opened it.
I see. Wanting the right color for safety is completely understandable. Let me just take a quick look at our return eligibility for you. One moment.
Thank you for holding. I've confirmed everything. Since the helmet was delivered within the last 90 days, you are definitely eligible to return it for a full refund.
Really? Oh, thank goodness. That's such a relief! I was so worried it had been too long. Thank you, David.

You're very welcome. I'm happy to help clear that up. I am sending a pre-paid return label to the email on file now. You can just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed.
That's wonderful. You've made this so easy. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a great day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
